title: The Lost Library
intro: You wake on a cold stone floor. Somewhere in this abandoned library is the legendary Python Codex. Type 'help' if you're lost.

goal.message: You carry the Python Codex into the moonlight. Its pages glow with perfectly tested code. You win!

hall.name: Great Hall
hall.description: Dust swirls in the moonlight. Tall doors lead north, and an archway opens to the east.

corridor.name: Narrow Corridor
corridor.description: Portraits of forgotten programmers line the walls. A staircase descends into darkness.

office.name: Librarian's Office
office.description: A desk covered in coffee rings. One drawer is slightly open.

reading_room.name: Reading Room
reading_room.description: Rows of empty desks. A heavy iron door blocks the way north.

archive.name: Archive
archive.description: Shelves vanish into the shadows. Something glints under a table.

vault.name: The Vault
vault.description: A single pedestal stands in a circle of light.

requires.message: The pedestal has an empty slot shaped like a gear. The Codex is sealed inside a glass case.

lamp.name: brass lamp
lamp.description: An old brass lamp. It still has oil.

note.name: crumpled note
note.description: It reads: 'The key to the vault is where the coffee is.'

key.name: iron key
key.description: A heavy iron key with a snake engraved on it.

book.name: dusty book
book.description: 'Clean Code' - someone left a bookmark at the chapter on functions.

gear.name: bronze gear
gear.description: A small bronze gear with 64 teeth.
